## Display custom GARLYN values in Sparky Mobile

This patch release makes the three GARLYN custom measurements visible in the
current Sparky Mobile daily form.

- `body_fat_mass_kg`, `muscle_percentage`, and `body_water_mass_kg` now use
  Sparky's `manual` source, which the mobile client prefills in its editable
  custom-measurement fields.
- The four native records keep the descriptive
  `GARLYN Scale via Home Assistant` source.
- The seven values, units, timestamps, daily coalescing, persistent outbox,
  retry behavior, and strict seven-record response validation are unchanged.
- Previously delivered history is not rewritten; the new source convention
  applies to measurements delivered after this update.

Sparky Mobile currently has no inputs for its native muscle-mass and body-water
percentage fields. This integration continues to populate both native values;
their mobile presentation is intentionally left to Sparky.

This is a Home Assistant-only update. The ESPHome component and transport
protocol are unchanged, so the ESP does not need to be reflashed.
